title: MCP and sandbox for publishing AI-built games and getting feedback
author: Playgama
selftext:
I’m guessing quite a few of you have tried making a game with the new models in Codex or Claude. If one of those experiments turned into a playable build that’s still sitting in your agent, you can publish it in a couple of minutes and get a public link to share.

I’m the community manager at Playgama, and our team built Playgama MCP for exactly this. It lets your agent publish directly to [Playgama.ai](http://playgama.ai/), our sandbox for AI-built games, without a manual upload.

Every game published there gets free traffic, so you can see how real people play, collect feedback, and work out what to improve. You can also track performance and earn some ad revenue along the way. [https://playgama.ai/play/](https://playgama.ai/play/)

If you give it a try, I’d love to hear how the setup went and what tools you’d like us to support next. [https://playgama.com/mcp/](https://playgama.com/mcp/)

comments.author: Able_Tell9927
comments.body: **I have one question. If I publish my game here to get feedback, doesn’t it make it easier for other people to copy the idea? Do you have any way to protect it? This is quite important to me.**

replies.author: Bluetails_Buizel
replies.body: I Can’t think of a way to protect it since anyone can describe what they can see to an llm these days… I hope someone in here is way more knowledgeable…

comments.author: Infinite_Ad_9204
comments.body: Which engines I can use to post my games there?

replies.author: Playgama
replies.body: if it's built in Codex or Claude you can publish the game via Playgama MCP in the sandbox
